title: One agenda owner for the Schedule tab: write-through mutations + live refresh
deviations_from_card: Acceptance grew from 7 to 9 cases (1b: a write response without the pipeline join keeps the agenda read's entryStatus/entryStage so canReinvite is not loosened; 5b: meeting_url merges a PARTIAL patch, since the PATCH can answer {meetingUrl:null}). Added a `reject` verb (grid Decline) to AGENDA_VERBS so it also notifies. accept_proposal also drops the entry's pending card write-through (not only via refetch), closing the stale-Confirm window before the re-read lands. Owner adds load sequencing (a read in flight when a write lands is dropped and re-issued) and skips its own notify echo for OWN_ECHO_WINDOW_MS=1000. The panel hook's toasts/busy/armed stay in the panel; the fetches moved to the owner (runInviteAction, reinviteEntry, adoptMeetingPatch). No catalog, route or schema change.
notes: Slot B extension points: scheduleAgenda.ts exports AGENDA_VERBS / EFFECTS (typed total, tsc refuses a verb with no row), applyMutation, adoptInvite, calendarEntryIdsOf, AgendaWriteResult, ScheduleAgendaView; useScheduleTab returns agendaForPanel and has commitMutation internally (B's sendLink should call commitMutation({kind:'reinvite', invite:null},{reload:true}) or add a 'send_link' verb). The `new Map(...)` last-wins invite-per-entry seed (B's liveInviteFor target) is untouched. data-sim-click="confirm" untouched (ScheduleTabPendingList.tsx not edited; case 7 pins it). Gates: tsc has zero errors in my files; whole-tree tsc red only on sibling in-flight paths (app/_lib/aging-policy/automation-pass/pipeline-automation-input tests, ModelsRoutingPanel.tsx) and the untracked kpi-sim/ tree. test:unit 9650/9657: the 7 failures are app/_lib DB tests (erasure-*-scrub, match-candidate, offers-store, pipeline-github-handle, rematch-source) touched by siblings' uncommitted app/_lib/db/pipeline.ts etc.; this change is client-only and nothing in app/_lib imports it. test:perf red only on app/api/**/route.ts graph overrides (sibling app/_lib growth), no line on schedule or app/page.tsx. eslint: 0 errors, 1 pre-existing warning (exhaustive-deps on the mount-load effect, same shape as base). Stale comment left outside the write set: app/features/shared/sharedGet.ts:5-12 still cites the Schedule grid + lifecycle panel as its motivating sibling pair; that pair no longer double-fetches (coordinator may reword it). Known edge: if /api/pipeline fails on first load, the panel stays on its invisible placeholder (entries null) while the tab shows the load error. Side finding from the card (SCHEDULE_LIST_MAX 1000 vs store clamp 500 -> truncated lies above 499) not addressed.
